steps.title: Type the email
steps.say: On the sign-in page, click the email box and type the staff email. Recover Password is there if they have forgotten it.

steps.title: Type the password
steps.say: Click the password box and type the password. It must be at least 6 characters. Keep me logged in is optional.

steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.say: Click Login to Dashboard. The next screen shows the school name and the active term.

steps.title: Open the photo menu
steps.say: Settings, My profile, Change Active Term, Change password, and Logout are under the photo at the top right, not in the left menu. Click the photo.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.say: Click Settings. Only posts allowed to manage the school see this line.

steps.title: Edit the school phone
steps.say: Open Basic school info. Double-click the phone value, type the school number, then press Enter or click outside. That saves it. Escape cancels.
steps.note: Double-click a value, edit it, then press Enter to save.

steps.title: Logo and signatures
steps.say: Click Logo and signatures. Upload the school logo, then the Head Teacher, matron, patron, and discipline signatures. Each upload saves that picture.
steps.note: Upload replaces the current picture and saves it.

steps.title: Registration fees
steps.say: Click Online registration fees and documents. Set the fee and the documents a new family must upload, then save that block.
steps.note: Save the block before you leave it.

steps.title: Required materials
steps.say: Click Student required materials. Add each item a student must bring, then save the list.
steps.note: These items are what Required Material Check looks for later.

steps.title: Dormitory setup
steps.say: Click Dormitories. Add the dormitory name and save it. Assigning a student to a room is done later from the Students menu.
steps.note: Save the dormitory before you assign students.

steps.title: Staff attendance times
steps.say: Click Staff attendance settings. Set the arrival and leaving times, then save.
steps.note: These times are what the staff attendance report uses.

steps.title: IN/OUT locations
steps.say: Click Student IN/OUT attendance locations. Type the gate or place name and click Add.
steps.note: Add each place the card reader uses.

steps.title: Parent visiting setup
steps.say: Click Parent visiting. Set how visits work for this school, then save the block.
steps.note: Save before you open the visiting menu.

steps.title: Timetable periods
steps.say: Click Timetable periods and breaks. Set the period times, then save.
steps.note: The timetable menu uses these periods.

steps.title: Pedagogical documents setup
steps.say: Click Pedagogical documents. Choose how schemes and lesson plans are stored, then save.
steps.note: Teachers use the Pedagogical Documents menu after this is saved.

steps.title: Card options
steps.say: Click Card options. Set how student and staff cards are printed, then save.
steps.note: Generate student cards and Generate staff cards use these options.

steps.title: Grade setting
steps.say: Click Grade Setting. Set the mark ranges and the grade names, then save.
steps.note: Reports use these grades after you save.

steps.title: SMS provider
steps.say: Click SMS provider. Check the provider and the remaining SMS credit, then save if you changed it. Messages only go out while credit remains.
steps.note: Parents messaging and discipline SMS both use this credit.

steps.title: Open Change Active Term
steps.say: Open the photo menu again and click Change Active Term. Marks, fees, and attendance all use the term you set here.

steps.title: Choose the academic year
steps.say: Click Academic Year and choose the year, for example 2026-2027. Add new only when that year does not exist yet.

steps.title: Choose the term
steps.say: Click Term and choose First Term, Second Term, or Third Term.

steps.title: Save the active term
steps.say: Type your password to confirm, then click Save Changes. The header will show the new term.

steps.title: Open Change password
steps.say: Open the photo menu and click Change password. Every staff member can change their own password here.

steps.title: Type the current password
steps.say: Click Current password and type the password they use today.

steps.title: Type the new password
steps.say: Click New Password and type at least 6 characters.

steps.title: Confirm and save the password
steps.say: Click Confirm Password and type the same new password, then click Change password.

steps.title: Open My profile
steps.say: Open the photo menu and click My profile. Every staff member can open this, including people who cannot open Settings.

steps.title: Choose Rwandan or not
steps.say: On the Identity card, click Rwandan for a national ID, or Non-Rwandan for a passport.
steps.note: The full identity form, including someone filling it for another staff member, is in the identity guide.

steps.title: Upload the ID or passport
steps.say: Click the file box and choose the ID or passport. JPG, PNG, or PDF, up to 5 megabytes.

steps.title: Save identity
steps.say: Click Save identity. The record is stored on this profile.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.say: Click Dashboard any time to return home. Leaders see the school summary. Other posts see the panel allowed for their role.
steps.note: The centre of the header shows the school and the active term.

steps.title: Export from school
steps.say: If Export from school or Child schools is on the menu, click the school name before you export. Back to master school returns you. Skip this when the menu is not there.
steps.note: A named school uses its own records. Do not export the master school when you meant a child school.

steps.title: Register new student
steps.say: Open Students, then Register new student. If this line is missing, that post cannot register.
steps.note: Example: register Jean Mukiza in S3 A.

steps.title: First name
steps.say: Click the first name and type Jean.

steps.title: Last name
steps.say: Click the last name and type Mukiza.

steps.title: Class
steps.say: Click the class and choose S3 A.

steps.title: Parent phone
steps.say: Click the parent phone and type the number that should receive SMS.

steps.title: Save the student
steps.say: Click Save. Jean Mukiza is now in the student list.

steps.title: View students
steps.say: Click View students. This is the list you search when a parent or a teacher asks about one child.
steps.note: Search by name, registration number, or parent phone.

steps.title: Search the student
steps.say: Click the search box and type Mukiza.

steps.title: Open the student
steps.say: Click the name Jean Mukiza to open the record, then save any change the post is allowed to make.

steps.title: Pending review
steps.say: Click Pending review. These are registrations that are not approved yet.
steps.note: Open the row, check the details, then approve.

steps.title: Approve the registration
steps.say: Click the pending row for the student, check the class, then click Approve.

steps.title: Dismissed students
steps.say: Click Dismissed students. Use this list to find a student who has left, not to register a new one.
steps.note: Search the name. Open the row to see why they left.

steps.title: Find a dismissed student
steps.say: Click search and type the name. Open the row to read the record. There is no save on this list.

steps.title: Generate student cards
steps.say: Click Generate student cards.
steps.note: Pick the class first so you do not print the whole school by mistake.

steps.title: Choose the class
steps.say: Click the class and choose S3 A.

steps.title: Generate the cards
steps.say: Click Generate. The cards use the photo and the card options saved in Settings.

steps.title: Student Photo
steps.say: Click Student Photo.
steps.note: Use a head-and-shoulders picture on a white background.

steps.title: Choose the student
steps.say: Search Jean Mukiza and click his name.

steps.title: Choose the photo
steps.say: Click the file box and choose the portrait.

steps.title: Save the photo
steps.say: Click Save. The new picture is the one that prints on the card.

steps.title: Assign Card
steps.say: Click Assign Card.
steps.note: One card belongs to one student. The page says Card Saved when the tap is stored.

steps.title: Find the student
steps.say: Search Jean Mukiza and click his name.

steps.title: Tap the card
steps.say: Click the card box and tap the student's card, or type the card number. The page saves it and shows Card Saved.

steps.title: Required Material Check
steps.say: Click Required Material Check.
steps.note: The items come from Student required materials in Settings.

steps.title: Choose the class
steps.say: Click the class and choose S3 A.

steps.title: Tick what the student brought
steps.say: On Jean Mukiza's row, tick each item he brought.

steps.title: Save the check
steps.say: Click Save. The check is stored for that day.

steps.title: Dormitories
steps.say: Click Dormitories under Students. This assigns a student to a room. Creating the dormitory itself is done in Settings.
steps.note: Example: put Jean Mukiza in room 12.

steps.title: Choose the student
steps.say: Search Jean Mukiza and click his name.

steps.title: Choose the room
steps.say: Click the room and choose room 12.

steps.title: Save the room
steps.say: Click Save. Jean Mukiza is now in that room.

steps.title: All families
steps.say: Open Families, then All families. If Families is missing, that post cannot open family sheets.
steps.note: Search the parent name or the phone.

steps.title: Search a family
steps.say: Click search and type the parent name, for example Uwase.

steps.title: Open the family
steps.say: Click the family name to open the sheet of children linked to that parent.

steps.title: Each family sheet
steps.say: Under Families, every named sheet is its own submenu. Click that sheet name, search the family, and open it. Repeat for each sheet name you see. Do not skip one.
steps.note: The sheet names differ by school. Open each one the same way.

steps.title: Classes
steps.say: Click Classes. This menu has no submenu. The list is the page.
steps.note: Each class belongs to a level. Marks and attendance start from a class.

steps.title: Open one class
steps.say: Click S3 A to open that class. Save only if you changed the class name, level, or department.

steps.title: Course Category
steps.say: Open Course, then Course Category.
steps.note: A category groups subjects, for example Sciences.

steps.title: Category name
steps.say: Click the name and type Sciences.

steps.title: Save the category
steps.say: Click Save. The category can now be chosen when you create a course.

steps.title: Create Course
steps.say: Click Create Course.
steps.note: Example: Mathematics in the Sciences category.

steps.title: Course name
steps.say: Click the course name and type Mathematics.

steps.title: Course category
steps.say: Click the category and choose Sciences.

steps.title: Save the course
steps.say: Click Save. Mathematics now exists and can be assigned.

steps.title: Manage Course
steps.say: Click Manage Course. This is where a course is assigned to a class and a teacher.
steps.note: A teacher's marks follow the courses assigned here.

steps.title: Choose the course
steps.say: Click the course and choose Mathematics for S3 A.

steps.title: Save the assignment
steps.say: Choose the teacher, then click Save.

steps.title: Record Entry
steps.say: Open Behavior, then Record Entry. If Behavior is missing, that post cannot write a discipline case.
steps.note: Example: Jean Mukiza in S3 A, one conduct code, then Save.

steps.title: Search the student
steps.say: Click Search by Student and type Mukiza. You can also use Search by Class or Scan by Card.

steps.title: Add the student
steps.say: Click Jean Mukiza so his name appears in the student list. The case is saved for the students in that list.
steps.note: The list stays empty until you click the name.

steps.title: Choose the conduct code
steps.say: Click School conduct code and search by the number or the words. Click the code that matches what happened.

fields.label: School conduct code
fields.value: Search the code, then click it

steps.note: The blue step is deducted automatically for this student.

steps.title: Reduce discipline marks
steps.say: Leave Reduce discipline marks selected when marks should go down. Send remarks to parent only sends a remark and does not reduce marks.

steps.title: Notify the parent
steps.say: Tick Notify parent only when the parent should receive an SMS. Leave it off when you only want the record saved.

steps.title: Save the discipline record
steps.say: Click Save. The page says the record was saved and is ready for the next student.

steps.title: Completed Discipline Entry
steps.say: Click Completed Discipline Entry. This list shows cases already saved.
steps.note: Open Jean Mukiza's row to confirm the code and the marks that were taken.

steps.title: Open the saved case
steps.say: Click Jean Mukiza's row. Check the code and the marks, then save only if you are correcting that case.

steps.title: Discipline Record
steps.say: Click Discipline Record. Use this to look up a past case.
steps.note: Search the student. This page is the history, not the place to start a new case.

steps.title: Find the record
steps.say: Click search and type Mukiza, then open the row.

steps.title: Permission Entry
steps.say: Open Permissions, then Permission Entry. Use this when a student is allowed out of school.
steps.note: Example: Jean Mukiza leaves for a clinic and returns the same day.

steps.title: Add the student
steps.say: Search Mukiza and click Jean Mukiza so he is in the list.

steps.title: Leave and return time
steps.say: Click Leave Time and Return Time and set when he leaves and when he must be back.

steps.title: Destination
steps.say: Click Destination and type where he is going, for example Clinic.

steps.title: Reason
steps.say: Click Reason and type why he is leaving. At least a few words.

steps.title: Save the permission
steps.say: Tick Notify parent by SMS only if the parent should be told. Then click Save.

steps.title: Permission report
steps.say: Click Permission report.
steps.note: Leaders use this list to see who was allowed out.

steps.title: Open the report
steps.say: Choose the dates, then click the button that shows the report. Jean Mukiza's clinic permission should be on it.

steps.title: Assign visitors
steps.say: Open Parent visiting, then Assign visitors.
steps.note: Example: Aline Uwase visits Jean Mukiza.

steps.title: Choose the student
steps.say: Search Jean Mukiza and click his name.

steps.title: Visitor name
steps.say: Click the visitor name and type Aline Uwase, and the phone if the form asks for it.

steps.title: Save the visitor and card
steps.say: Click Save visitor and card when they need a card. Click Save visitor only when no card is needed.

steps.title: Print visitor cards
steps.say: Click Print visitor cards.
steps.note: Print Aline Uwase's card after it is saved.

steps.title: Print the card
steps.say: Select Aline Uwase, then click Print.

steps.title: Verify visit
steps.say: Click Verify visit. This is the gate check when the visitor arrives.
steps.note: Search the visitor or scan the card, then confirm they are allowed in.

steps.title: Confirm the visit
steps.say: Click Aline Uwase, then confirm the visit.

steps.title: Parent visiting report
steps.say: Click Visiting report under Parent visiting.
steps.note: This report is the parent visits. Daily visiting has its own report.

steps.title: Show the parent visits
steps.say: Choose the day, then show the report.

steps.title: Currently inside
steps.say: Open Daily visiting, then Currently inside. This is the live list of guests on the campus now.
steps.note: A name stays here until they are signed out.

steps.title: Daily visiting report
steps.say: Click Visiting report under Daily visiting. This is for other guests, not the parent-visitor cards.
steps.note: Choose the day and show the report.

steps.title: Show the daily report
steps.say: Choose today, then click the button that shows the report.

steps.title: Marks Entry
steps.say: Open Marks, then Marks Entry. A window opens before the mark sheet.
steps.note: Example: CAT marks for Mathematics, class S3 A, Jean Mukiza scores 16 out of 20.

steps.title: Marks type
steps.say: Click the marks type and choose CAT. A locked type cannot be selected until a leader unlocks it.

steps.title: Active term
steps.say: Check the active term. Leaders can change it here. Other posts keep the term already set in the header.

steps.title: Open the mark sheet
steps.say: Click Go. The mark sheet for that type and term opens.

steps.title: Choose the course
steps.say: Click Course and choose Mathematics.

steps.title: Choose the class
steps.say: Click Class and choose S3 A.

steps.title: Cat type
steps.say: Click Cat Type and choose the assessment, for example CAT 1.

steps.title: Total marks
steps.say: Click Total Marks and type 20.

steps.title: Date given
steps.say: Click Date Given and choose the day of the assessment.

steps.title: Type the student's mark
steps.say: On Jean Mukiza's row, click the mark box and type 16. A mark above the total is rejected.
steps.note: Do this for each student on the sheet before you save.

steps.title: Save the marks
steps.say: Click Save. The marks for Mathematics, S3 A, stay on this term.

steps.title: Lock Marks editing
steps.say: Click Lock Marks editing when this post is allowed. Locking stops teachers changing marks after the deadline. Skip it when the line is missing.
steps.note: Unlock only when a correction was approved.

steps.title: Marks sheet
steps.say: Click Marks sheet to see marks already saved.
steps.note: Choose the class and the course, then open the sheet. Export PDF is on this page.

steps.title: Open the saved sheet
steps.say: Choose S3 A and Mathematics, then open the sheet. Jean Mukiza should show 16.

steps.title: Progress Reports
steps.say: Click Progress Reports.
steps.note: Pick the class, then export or publish.

steps.title: Produce the progress report
steps.say: Choose S3 A, then click the export button to download the report.

steps.title: Periodic report
steps.say: Click Periodic report. Choose the class and the period, then open or export it.
steps.note: This report follows the periodic assessment, not the end-of-term list.

steps.title: Open the periodic report
steps.say: Choose S3 A and the period, then export.

steps.title: Periodic Result
steps.say: Under the results group, click Periodic Result.
steps.note: Choose the class and open the result. Publish via SMS only when the school still has SMS credit.

steps.title: Open the periodic result
steps.say: Choose S3 A, then export. Use Publish via SMS only after a leader has checked the result.

steps.title: Proclamation list
steps.say: Click Proclamation list.
steps.note: Choose the class and export the list.

steps.title: Export the proclamation list
steps.say: Choose S3 A, then click Export.

steps.title: Term proclamation list
steps.say: Click Term proclamation list. This is the end-of-term list, separate from the periodic one.
steps.note: Choose the class and export.

steps.title: Export the term list
steps.say: Choose S3 A and First Term, then click Export.

steps.title: Deliberation
steps.say: Open Deliberation, then the Deliberation line. This is where the class decision is recorded.
steps.note: Record the decision for each student, then save.

steps.title: Save the deliberation
steps.say: Set Jean Mukiza's decision, then click Save.

steps.title: Finish deliberation
steps.say: Click Finish deliberation only when every decision is saved. Finishing moves students to the new class and cannot be undone.
steps.note: Do not click it during a practice. Leaders use it at the end of the term.

steps.title: Confirm finish
steps.say: Read the warning. Click the finish button only when the class decisions are final.
steps.note: After this, students move to the new class and there is no way back.

steps.title: Deliberation settings
steps.say: Click Deliberation settings. Set the rules the deliberation uses, then save.
steps.note: Save the rules before the class deliberation starts.

steps.title: Save the deliberation rules
steps.say: Set the criteria, then click Save.

steps.title: Analyse syllabus and curriculum
steps.say: Open Pedagogical Documents, then Analyse Syllabus and Weeks, or Curriculum. REB classes use Syllabus and Weeks breakdown. TVET classes use Curriculum and Chronogram.
steps.note: Upload the two documents for that class, then run the analysis.

steps.title: Run the analysis
steps.say: Choose the class, upload the syllabus or curriculum and the weekly file, then click the button that starts the analysis.

steps.title: Scheme of Work
steps.say: Click Scheme of Work.
steps.note: It is built from the analysis. Open it, check the weeks, then save.

steps.title: Save the scheme
steps.say: Check Mathematics for S3 A, then click Save.

steps.title: Session plan
steps.say: Click Session or Lesson Plan.
steps.note: Open the lesson, complete it, then save.

steps.title: Save the lesson plan
steps.say: Fill the lesson for this week, then click Save.

steps.title: Timetable
steps.say: Click Timetable Management. A teacher who only has My timetable opens that line instead and reads their own week.
steps.note: Place the lesson, then save the timetable.

steps.title: Save the timetable
steps.say: Put Mathematics for S3 A in the period, then click Save.

steps.title: Parents messaging
steps.say: Open Messaging, then Parents messaging. SMS goes out only when Settings still shows SMS credit.
steps.note: Example: tell S3 A parents about a meeting.

steps.title: Choose the parents
steps.say: Click the audience and choose S3 A, or the whole school if that is what was asked.

steps.title: Write the message
steps.say: Click the message and type the text parents should receive.

steps.title: Send to parents
steps.say: Click Send. Wait until the page confirms it was sent.

steps.title: Employees messaging
steps.say: Click Employees messaging. This sends to staff, not to parents.
steps.note: Choose the staff group, write the message, then send.

steps.title: Choose the staff
steps.say: Click the audience and choose the staff group.

steps.title: Write the staff message
steps.say: Click the message and type it.

steps.title: Send to staff
steps.say: Click Send.

steps.title: Record attendance
steps.say: Open Student Attendance, then Record attendance. A window opens.
steps.note: Example: mark Jean Mukiza present today.

steps.title: Choose the student
steps.say: Click the student box and choose Jean Mukiza.

steps.title: Choose the date
steps.say: Click the date and choose today.

steps.title: Save the attendance
steps.say: Click Save record.

steps.title: Student IN/OUT Attendance
steps.say: Click Student IN/OUT Attendance. It opens the card page. A tap at the gate records in or out. There is no separate save button.
steps.note: The places were added under Settings, Student IN/OUT attendance locations.

steps.title: Attendance report
steps.say: Click Attendance report.
steps.note: Choose the class and the month, then generate.

steps.title: Generate the attendance report
steps.say: Choose S3 A, then click Generate.

steps.title: Staff attendance report
steps.say: Open Staff Attendance, then Attendance Report.
steps.note: Choose the staff member and the dates, then generate.

steps.title: Generate the staff report
steps.say: Choose Aline Uwase, then click Generate. PDF all exports everyone.

steps.title: Record attendance with card
steps.say: Click Record Attendance With card. Staff tap their card. The page records the time. There is no extra save.
steps.note: The arrival times come from Staff attendance settings.

steps.title: Add new staff
steps.say: Under HR, open Staffs, then Add new staff. A window opens.
steps.note: Example: add Aline Uwase as Support.

steps.title: Staff name
steps.say: Click the name and type Aline Uwase.

steps.title: Post
steps.say: Click the post and choose the job, for example Support.

steps.title: Staff email
steps.say: Click the email and type the address they will use to sign in.

steps.title: Save the staff member
steps.say: Click Save. They can then open My profile and fill identity.

steps.title: View all staffs
steps.say: Click View all staffs.
steps.note: Search a name, open it, and use Excel, PDF, Courses PDF, or IDs PDF when that post may export.

steps.title: Search a staff member
steps.say: Click search and type Uwase, then click Aline Uwase.

steps.title: Download the IDs PDF
steps.say: Click IDs PDF when the post is allowed. The Director of Finance uses this to download identifications. Choose the school first if Export from school is on the menu.

steps.title: Generate staff cards
steps.say: Click Generate staff cards.
steps.note: Choose the staff, then generate. The photo must already be on the profile.

steps.title: Generate the staff card
steps.say: Choose Aline Uwase, then click Generate.

steps.title: Fees Entry
steps.say: Open Finance, then Fees Management, then Fees Entry.
steps.note: Example: record a payment for Jean Mukiza.

steps.title: Find the student
steps.say: Search Jean Mukiza and click his name. The fees summary opens.

steps.title: Record invoice
steps.say: Click Record Invoice.

steps.title: Amount received
steps.say: Tick the fee line, then type the amount received. It cannot be more than the balance.

steps.title: Payment mode
steps.say: Click the payment mode and choose how the money was paid.

steps.title: Save the payment
steps.say: Click Save. Then print the receipt from Payment history if the parent needs it.

steps.title: School fees management
steps.say: Click School fees management. This sets the fee. It does not record a payment.
steps.note: Set the amount for the class, then save.

steps.title: Set the school fee
steps.say: Choose S3 A and type the fee amount.

steps.title: Save the school fee
steps.say: Click Save.

steps.title: Extra fees management
steps.say: Click Extra fees management.
steps.note: Example: a uniform fee.

steps.title: Extra fee name
steps.say: Click the name and type Uniform.

steps.title: Extra fee amount
steps.say: Click the amount and type it.

steps.title: Save the extra fee
steps.say: Click Save. It can then be charged from Fees Entry, Add extra.

steps.title: Fees report
steps.say: Click Fees report.
steps.note: This is the summary the Director of Finance checks.

steps.title: Open the fees report
steps.say: Choose the term, then open or export the report.

steps.title: Budget dashboard
steps.say: Under Finance, open Budget and Cash Flow, then Dashboard.
steps.note: This is the budget home, not the school dashboard.

steps.title: Prepare Budget
steps.say: Click Prepare Budget.
steps.note: Upload the budget file, then extract the lines.

steps.title: Upload the budget
steps.say: Choose the file, then click Upload and extract lines.

steps.title: Requests and approvals
steps.say: Click Requests and Approvals.
steps.note: A new request starts here and moves through approval.

steps.title: New cash request
steps.say: Click New request. Fill the amount and the reason, then submit it.

steps.title: Budget reports
steps.say: Click Reports under Budget and Cash Flow. Open the report a leader asked for. This is separate from Fees report.
steps.note: Use it to check requests, payments, and the audit trail.

steps.title: Fixed assets
steps.say: Open Fixed assets.
steps.note: Example: register one classroom desk.

steps.title: Asset name
steps.say: Click the name and type Desk, and the location if the form asks.

steps.title: Save the asset
steps.say: Click Save.

steps.title: Library
steps.say: Click Library.
steps.note: Add a book or record a borrow, then save.

steps.title: Save the book
steps.say: Type the book title, then click Save.

steps.title: Bus Management
steps.say: Open Transport Management, then Bus Management.
steps.note: Add the bus, then save.

steps.title: Save the bus
steps.say: Type the bus name or plate, then click Save.

steps.title: Route management
steps.say: Click Route management.
steps.note: Add the route and the bus that runs it, then save.

steps.title: Save the route
steps.say: Type the route name, then click Save.

steps.title: Pocket Money
steps.say: Click Pocket Money.
steps.note: Choose the dates and click Apply to see the transactions.

steps.title: Show pocket money
steps.say: Set the dates, then click Apply. Send back is a separate button on a row and needs the agent to approve.

steps.title: Canteen
steps.say: Click Canteen.
steps.note: Add an item with its price, then save.

steps.title: Canteen item
steps.say: Click the item name and type Bread.

steps.title: Canteen price
steps.say: Click the price and type the amount in francs.

steps.title: Save the canteen item
steps.say: Click Save. Add item is for another row. Remove deletes one.

steps.title: Leave Application
steps.say: Click Leave Application.
steps.note: A staff member asks for their own leave here.

steps.title: Apply for leave
steps.say: Click Apply for Leave.

steps.title: From date
steps.say: Click From date and choose the first day.

steps.title: To date
steps.say: Click To date and choose the last day.

steps.title: Leave reason
steps.say: Click Reason and type why, for example Family.

steps.title: Submit the leave
steps.say: Click Save. The request waits in Leave Management.

steps.title: Leave Management
steps.say: Click Leave Management. This is for the posts that approve leave.
steps.note: Open the request, approve it, and print it if a paper copy is needed.

steps.title: Approve the leave
steps.say: Click Aline Uwase's request, then click Approve. Print is on the same row.

steps.title: Preps invigilation
steps.say: Click Preps invigilation.
steps.note: Set who supervises, then save.

steps.title: Save preps invigilation
steps.say: Choose the prep and the staff member, then click Save preps invigilation.

steps.title: Prep attendance
steps.say: Click Prep attendance.
steps.note: Choose the day and show the report.

steps.title: Show prep attendance
steps.say: Choose today, then click Show report.

steps.title: Log out
steps.say: Open the photo menu and click Logout when the work is finished.
